cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. My tea's stronger than yours. I can handle it without milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same teapot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. First to finish, then. I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fewest refills wins, then. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.
